caption: The video captures a dark, wet nighttime road viewed from a fixed camera, where moving lights dominate over resolved vehicles. A row of orange streetlights recedes into the distance on the left, and oncoming headlights form white starburst points with long vertical reflections on the slick pavement, the clusters holding position with minor flicker. On the right stands a low building bearing a small neon sign and a horizontal strip of lit panels, under bright overhead lamps. Two bright white horizontal streaks, one above the other, travel steadily rightward along the road, shrinking to a fragment at the edge before disappearing. A red light trail in the center likewise slides rightward across the clip, shifting from the middle toward the right-center and still visible in the last frame. A darker vehicle silhouette carrying red taillights on the right-center shows only a slight positional drift. The background streetlights and signage remain fixed throughout, confirming the camera is stationary.
